tha-ap190:1.1: Tikaṇṇipupphiya.] Devabhūto ahaṃ santo accharāhi purakkhato / pubbaṃ kammaṃ saritvāna Buddhaseṭṭham anussariṃ // //
tha-ap190:2.1: Tikaṇṇipupphaṃ paggayha sakaṃ cittaṃ pasādayiṃ / Buddhassa abhiropesiṃ Vipassimhi narāsabhe // //
tha-ap190:3.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap190:4.1: Tesattati ito kappe catur āsuṃ naruttamā / sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahabbalā. // //
tha-ap190:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Tikaṇṇipupphiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
